largeheadline.line1: O Series cutting accessories and tool steel burs are designed for use with the 5407-210-020 PD series straight short O attachment.

AM series cutting accessories and tool steel burs are designed for use with these attachments: 5400-210-070 PD series straight long AM, 5400-210-072 PD series angled long AM, 5407-120-070 HD 14 cm straight AM and 5407-120-072 HD 14 cm angled AM
R series cutting accessories and tool steel burs are designed for use with the 5400-210-080 PD series straight extra long R attachment.
RX series cutting accessories and tool steel burs are designed for use with the 5400-210-090 PD series extra long straight RX attachment.

M series cutting accessories and tool steel burs are designed for use with these attachments: 5400-210-050 PD series straight M, 5400-210-052 PD series angled M, 5407-120-050 HD 9 cm straight M and 5407-120-052 HD 9 cm angled M.

M series cutting accessories and tool steel burs are designed for use with these attachments: 5400-210-050 PD series straight M, 5400-210-052 PD series angled M, 5407-120-050 HD 9 cm straight M and 5407-120-052 HD 9 cm angled M.
